description: MAX, MIN and MODE do not order a semi-structured value: they reject OBJECT, ARRAY and structured OBJECT/MAP columns (naming the whole parameterised type), in DISTINCT/windowed forms, over empty inputs, through casts to OBJECT/ARRAY (TRY_CAST included), conditionals and producer functions - while the bound holds everywhere else: a VARIANT is never rejected even holding an object (MAX(vo) returns the object), casts and TRY_CASTs to VARIANT are accepted, VARIANT producers and path reads pass, grouping/sorting/partitioning/DISTINCT/joins/set-ops/IN still take semi-structured keys, the non-ordering aggregates all accept, casting to VARCHAR works for the PLAIN types alone (the structured CAST/ARRAY_AGG divergence pinned beside its plain twin), and ordinary scalars are unaffected. Converted 1:1 from expressions/SemiStructuredOrderingAggregateTest (now retired).
